result:
If I could change the world in one way, I’d give people a deeper capacity for empathy—the ability to genuinely understand and feel what others experience, especially those different from themselves.

So much harm—conflict, cruelty, neglect, exploitation—comes from an inability or unwillingness to see others as fully real. Greater empathy wouldn’t solve every problem, but it would make people far more likely to cooperate, act justly, and care for one another and the planet.
